label: Impact and shock conditions
description: Records the projectile, target and shock state of impact and shock experiments or models. Applies to light-gas-gun, laser, dust-accelerator and numerical impact studies.
covers: Impact velocity, shock pressure, shock and post-shock temperature, shock duration, impact angle, and projectile and target material and size.
